findings.title: Stats error state has no retry; the same range can't be reloaded without a page reload
findings.steps: Open /stats while the API is failing (e.g. down or returning 500), then bring the API back. Or open /stats?from=2026-05-01&to=2026-01-01.
findings.expected: The error message comes with a Retry button that calls refresh() and loads the data once the server is back.
findings.actual: Only an AlertMessage is shown. useApiFetch's refresh is never exposed. The only ways to refetch are changing a date or reloading the page.
findings.evidence:
SSR HTML for /stats?from=2026-05-01&to=2026-01-01 contains just
The From date must be on or before the To date.
with no button. stats.vue pulls only data/error/status out of useApiFetch, not refresh.

findings.title: Stats request has no timeout, so 'Loading stats…' can spin forever
findings.steps: Make the API hang (accept the connection, never answer), then open /stats or change a date.
findings.expected: The request is cut off after 10 s and the page shows an error with a retry.
findings.actual: Neither useApiFetch nor useApiClient sets a timeout, so the page shows 'Loading stats…' (or the old table) indefinitely.
findings.evidence: composables/useApi.ts: useFetch/$fetch.create are called without a timeout option, and stats.vue passes none either.

findings.title: Clearing a date field leaves it blank while the results silently use a different date
findings.steps: On /stats, clear the From field (or set a range, then clear To).
findings.expected: The field is refused with a visible reason, or goes back to its default value.
findings.actual: The param is dropped from the query and the server quietly uses Jan 1 / Dec 31 of the current year. The input stays empty, and the 'This year' reset button can appear even though the data shown is for this year. Also, a cleared To removes the min/max constraint.
findings.evidence: stats.vue: the query computed omits empty values, and stats.py falls back to year_bounds() when the param is missing.

findings.title: Typing a year in the date input fires a request on every keystroke and flashes a validation error
findings.steps: In Chrome, put the cursor in the To field's year segment and type 2026.
findings.expected: No request for half-typed dates, or at least no error flash.
findings.actual: v-model updates to 0002-12-31, 0020-12-31, 0202-12-31 in turn. Each one starts a fetch and comes back 422 ('The From date must be on or before the To date.'), so the error alert flashes over the table before the full year is typed.
findings.evidence: The query is a computed directly on the v-model refs with no debounce or check. The API returns 422 for to < from (verified with curl).

findings.title: Long unbroken plant variety can overflow the Best-plants cards at 375 px
findings.steps: Create a plant whose variety is 80 characters with no spaces, give it a harvest, then view /stats at 375 px wide.
findings.expected: The text wraps or truncates inside the card.
findings.actual: .stat__hint has no overflow-wrap/word-break, so the long token pushes past the card and can cause sideways scrolling.
findings.evidence: main.css .stat__hint sets only margin, font-size and color. stats.vue renders the variety in .stat__hint.
